entry: Chose the niche and scaffolded the studio: simulation-driven science shorts, one measured claim per video, seed on screen.
Built and verified the voiceover round-trip check (speak, transcribe, diff). Measured pace: 3.3 words per second.
Channel created. OAuth access verified: token scoped to Seed Zero only; private test upload and delete succeeded.
Built the composition pipeline: seeded music, character-budget captions, seed overlay, preview, contact sheet. Deterministic reruns verified.
Branding done: deterministic avatar and banner. Banner, description, and keywords set via API; avatar needs a manual Studio upload.
First short produced and uploaded private: Galton board, seed 0. Measured 2181 center vs 3 at both edges; theory says 924 paths to 1. Video K_ntI_mY4v0.
Owner approved the pilot. First video is PUBLIC. Seed Zero is live.
Double pendulum short produced: 110 deg release, 0.001 deg delta, split at 9.8 s, gap wider than the pendulum at 14.9 s. Private as BU_j-UbPR7k.
Scufris integration designed: widget from web/status.json, triggers via .scufris.toml claude jobs, 2-3 daily slots via systemd timers. See docs/scufris-integration.md.

Day one wrap: two videos public, self-QA publishing authorized, repo renamed to seedzero, scufris triggers committed, morning-briefing extension designed and tasked in scufris2 (20260830-212048). Next: Monty Hall.
Added GitHub Pages CI/CD for the status page. Pushes to master now deploy the web folder.
Normalized the status page data into JSON and timestamped JSONL files, and added client-side pagination for videos, ideas, and logs.
Merged videos and ideas into one slate and tightened the status page spacing.
Refreshed YouTube data after verifying the OAuth token sees only Seed Zero: 1 subscriber, 2 public videos, and 14 views across those videos.

Produced and published the Monty Hall short: 10,000 games at seed 0, every game scored both ways; stay won 3,308, switch won 6,692 (2.02 to 1). Voice round-trip passed; contact-sheet inspection caught caption collisions, fixed by moving to horizontal racing bars. https://youtu.be/cT8Tcjm7mUs
Refreshed YouTube data: 1 subscriber, 3 public videos, 15 views (Galton 5, pendulum 10, Monty Hall 0). YouTube reconciled the Galton count down from 6.

Added the research-trends skill and a research agent in .scufris.toml: web research for trending niche subjects, filtered down to ideas a deterministic in-repo sim can turn into one measured surprising number, recorded in docs/niche.md and a Tatr task.

First research-trends run: three parallel web agents (trends, news pegs, audience questions) produced 18 candidates; 9 new backlog ideas added to docs/niche.md (pendulum wave, streak test, seven shuffles, busy beaver BB(5), coin flip for a million, random vs balanced, golden angle, pi race, best of seven), 4 merged into existing entries, 2 rejected as already produced. Time-sensitive pegs: coin-flip poll by mid Sep, Turing 90 through Dec. Evidence in task 20260830-222119.

Set the cadence policy in AGENTS.md with the owner: quality over quantity, up to 3 uploads/day, hard cap 5 (quota retry headroom), ramp to 4-5 only after ~20 shorts with retention data and a 15+ idea backlog; research-trends runs weekly.

Morning analytics pull: 2 subscribers, 583 views (Galton 160, pendulum 394, Monty Hall 29), 11 likes, 0 dislikes, 1 comment on Galton (unreadable: token lacks youtube.force-ssl scope). Retention rows still empty; Analytics API lags 24-48h. Quota day resets at midnight Pacific, 10:00 local.

Re-auth complete with the youtube.force-ssl scope. Comment reads verified via API (first comment: plinko, on the Galton short). Token still sees exactly the Seed Zero channel. Comment policy: read-only, no replies without an owner-agreed policy.

Produced and published the Boids short: 200 boids at seed 0, sync 7% to snap at 7.78 s (hold above 0.9), collapse to 50% with alignment toggled off, re-snap 1.67 s after toggle-on, end 97%. Fixed % folding in normalize.py; retimed narration to visual anchors after first contact sheet. Uploaded on the expiring Aug 30 Pacific quota day. https://youtu.be/-hm9P9TXi60

Produced two more shorts, awaiting the 10:00 quota reset to upload: pendulum wave (30 pendulums one swing apart, mirror at 15.0 s, order 0.000 at 25 s, realign gap 0.0 px at exactly 30.0 s) and sorting race (quicksort 4,461 vs bubble 130,680 comparisons on the same 512-bar shuffle, 29.3 to 1, shared 4,356 comps/s replay rate). Both passed voice round-trip and contact-sheet QA.

Published the pendulum wave short: 30 pendulums one swing apart realign to a 0.000 px gap at exactly 30.0 s, mirror at 15.0 s, phase coherence 0.000 at 25 s. Uploaded on the fresh Pacific quota day, QA passed (PT41S, metadata verified). https://youtu.be/kIuhNc9TguE

Published the sorting race short: quicksort 4,461 vs bubble 130,680 comparisons on the same 512-bar shuffle (29.3 to 1), shared replay rate 4,356 comparisons/s. QA passed (PT41S, metadata verified). Day's three-upload cadence slot is full; both day2 tasks closed.
